name: Pipeliners - Internal Linking Plan 2026-08-27
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-08-27

# Summary
Research and audit only (nothing edited). Part 1 lists 2026 internal linking guidance (2-5 contextual links per 1,000 words, under 150 links per page, 3-click depth, hub-and-spoke plus spoke cross-links, descriptive anchors, body links over nav links). Part 2 audits all 108 published URLs, excluding nav and footer.

# Key findings
- 366 contextual internal links site-wide (about 3.4 per URL); 35 of 108 URLs had no outbound body link.
- /services-areas/ linked to only 1 of 37 cities in its body.
- 20 of 37 city pages had zero contextual inbound links; 12 more had only the generic Services page. Only Mesa, Phoenix, Chandler, Tempe and Scottsdale were well linked (from monsoon posts).
- City pages were dead ends: 64 links to /services/, 52 to /contact/, only 3 to a specific service page, 0 city-to-city, 0 to blogs.
- Anchors: "here!" 73 times, "contact us" 53, empty 16; 39% of links meaningless.
- 27 of 56 blog posts had no contextual inbound link.
- The nav was a 48-item wall with all 37 cities in one dropdown.

# Action list (as proposed)
1. Rebuild /services-areas/ to link all 37 cities by region (note: later standing rule says never edit live /services-areas/ without asking; its city list is script-built).
2. Three contextual service links per city page.
3. Cross-link genuine neighbors by cluster (West Valley, Northwest, East Valley, Northeast, Pinal).
4. Replace "here!" and empty anchors with human judgement.
5. Reconnect the 27 stranded posts.

# Status (from the handoff)
By Oct 1: 968 body links, 0 broken; "here!" anchors down from 73 to 11; internal links rolled out to city pages; orphan fix Oct 1.
